summary: Sandbach United are getting ready for the upcoming 26/27 season with just one week to go, having welcomed several new signings and one returning player to strengthen the squad. The Ramblers showed competitive spirit in a recent friendly against St Helens despite coming up short, and the club is actively seeking sponsorship partners to support their promotion push. With three brand new kits unveiled and squad details being rolled out, there's plenty of exciting developments as the campaign approaches.
